heroHeadline: Tense Standoff Persists as Bangkok Rejects Cambodia's Claims at Regional Summits
heroSubtitle: Thailand's Foreign Ministry on November 16 rejected Cambodia's allegations at the Francophonie and ASEAN-related meetings, urging bilateral resolution. ASEAN observers reported on November 5 that a Thai observation post had moved about 20 metres forward in Pursat, while the two sides dispute how many civilians remain unable to return home (Cambodia ~20,000; Thailand ~4,600 in three communities). No new armed clashes were reported and Thailand reaffirmed its commitment to the ceasefire accord.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
